key_insight: Quantum reinforcement learning lets musical agents develop distinct compositional mindsets through rewarded interaction rather than imitation of large music corpora.
engineering_relevance: The framework offers a hybrid quantum-classical approach to adaptive MIDI-based composition and performance with multiple musical agents.
method: Represent musical agents with parameterised quantum circuits in a reinforcement-learning loop.
Use atomistic agents for separate pitch and rhythm decisions, or holistic agents for unified pitch-duration events.
Combine and weight musically grounded rewards to shape distinct agent behaviours.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports generalisation to unseen musical material, interactive and offline MIDI demonstrations, and musically meaningful learning on IBM quantum hardware.
watch_item: The abstract provides no quantitative benchmarks or evidence of advantage over classical reinforcement learning, leaving comparative performance and scalability unresolved.
paper_title: Beyond Corpus-Driven Imitation: Evolving Musical Mindsets in the Agentic Orchestra via Quantum Reinforcement Learning
